The Show-Ready Sale

You hand Jack the keys. He hands you back a sold sign.

A good sale starts before the first showing. Jack helps coordinate preparation, photography, and pricing so you have a clear plan for bringing your home to market.

01

Walk-through & plan

Jack helps you weigh repairs and improvements against your budget, timing, and likely buyer expectations.

02

He runs the work

Jack gets the bids, then his contractors, cleaners, and stagers make the house show-ready. He helps keep the preparation on track.

03

Model-home marketing

Professional photography, virtual tours, and pricing built on decades of San Joaquin County sales data.

04

Escrow to sold

Offers, negotiation, inspections, paperwork — Jack walks the sale all the way to closing day.

The agent who answers his own phone.

Jack Klemm has sold homes across San Joaquin County since 1988 — nearly four thousand of them, a good share right here in Manteca. He's not a team with his name on it. When you call, you get Jack: the same person who prices your home, runs the contractors, and negotiates your contract.
